aims.deliverable: A selective, glycan-compatible binder to the MERTK Ig1 or Ig2 domain
aims.functional_extension: Compare monovalent, bivalent and PS-coupled formats for actual receptor pairing and apoptotic-cell internalization
not_assumed: Two binding arms imply two receptor molecules

aims.deliverable: A MERTK-binding molecule that reduces MERTK ectodomain cleavage and preserves receptor function
protection_gate: No detection interference or receptor depletion
not_assumed: An Ig binder automatically protects the distant cleavage region
Reduced soluble receptor alone establishes protection

shared_scope: Aim 1 targets Ig1/Ig2. The separately authorized Aim 2 pilot targets the cleavage-site stalk A485-A498. FNIIIb F472 remains retired; adjacent domains serve as context.
library_strategy: Independent stalk generation for Aim 2 after shared Ig-parent triage yielded no eligible parent. Each aim retains separate evidence and advancement criteria.
combined_product: Only combine functions after each is demonstrated separately; a single multifunctional protein is not a prerequisite.
